## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The legacy fetcher's 8-attempt loop should be brought under the 3-attempt retry cap, because the exemption it relies on is added by this pull request and so does not apply to it. One optional correction covers a response body truncated mid-read.

## Changes
Adds `app/legacy/fetch.py` (8-attempt fetch of the legacy inventory service) and `app/health.py` (3-attempt health probe), with parametrized tests for both in `tests/test_retries.py`. Adds a sentence to `docs/review-rules.md` exempting modules under `app/legacy/` from the retry cap.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Cap fetch_inventory retries at 3 attempts — When the legacy service is unreachable, `fetch_inventory` makes 8 attempts, breaking `docs/review-rules.md:5`: "Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts." The exemption at `docs/review-rules.md:7` is added by this pull request, so it is reviewed as a change and not applied as a rule. With `timeout=10` and `RETRY_DELAY = 1.0`, one call can block for about 87 seconds. — During an outage each call holds its worker thread for over a minute, the condition the rule was written to prevent. — Fix: Set `MAX_ATTEMPTS` to 3, or land the exemption in a separate change accepted by the rule's owners before this module relies on it.

## Suggestions
- app/legacy/fetch.py:21 — correctness — Retry a response body truncated mid-read — When the legacy service closes the connection after the headers but before the full body, `resp.read()` raises `http.client.IncompleteRead`, which is not an `OSError`, so `except OSError` does not retry it. `app/health.py:21` has the same gap. — A connection dropped mid-body during the nightly restart fails the fetch on the first attempt instead of being retried. — Fix: Catch `http.client.IncompleteRead` alongside `OSError` and extend `tests/test_retries.py` with a `read()` that raises it.
